kernel_owner_verification.finding: The kernel_committed_state_t public accessors and snapshot guard lineage, revision and committed time, but its read-only interface shown here does not expose a linked kernel_parameters_t identity or authenticated z/dz geometry. The existing hydraulic binding returns pressures and water contents and the heat sampler checks node number, not parameter geometry.
kernel_owner_verification.non_solution: Do not infer certified grid identity from matching active_nodes, matching lengths, or a caller supplied parameter_set_id.
kernel_owner_verification.safety_decision: No physical sowing, preparation or germination forcing may be committed via these view-only APIs until a parameter-owner certificate is bound to the identical committed physical state and validated for restart and retry.
kernel_owner_verification.next_gate: Identify B110 model's actual parameter-owner binding and propose a read-only certificate with negative mismatched parameter_set_id, permuted equally sized dz, stale revision, foreign lineage, altered time, heat disabled and restart cases. Require O0/O2 and F-CI B19/MICRO gates before admission.
